lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Put that sandwich down right now [beat] unless you want to get expelled by the guy who actually owns this kitchen!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Nix, you are just a student with a rusty scooter [beat], you can't possibly claim ownership of the school's entire food supply!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It started with a midnight craving [beat], but while everyone was sleeping, I signed an exclusive distribution deal with every vendor in town.

lines.speaker: choto
lines.text: He’s telling the truth, Principal! If I don't follow his menu [beat], I don't get a single bag of chips or a bottle of soda for the next month!

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: This has to be illegal [beat], nobody gives a teenager the keys to the kingdom just because he has a fast scooter and some spare cash!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Shut your mouth, Sam! [beat] You're just mad because your VIP snack pass was revoked the moment you tried to snitch on my operation.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: I told you the boy had a vision [beat]; he didn't just buy the snacks, he bought the logistics company that delivers them to your doorstep.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Nix, I thought you were just going out for a late-night burger [beat], not building a monopoly that has the principal shaking in her boots!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: There must be a price [beat], name it, because we cannot have a fourteen-year-old deciding who gets to eat lunch and who goes hungry.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The price is simple: no more Saturday detentions [beat] and double portions of fries for every student who actually works for my delivery fleet.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I’ll handle the heavy lifting, Boss! [beat] Just make sure nobody touches my stash of spicy wings while I’m on the clock or there will be trouble!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: I don't care how many schools you own [beat], you are still coming home right now to finish your actual math homework, Mr. CEO!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how a midnight craving [beat] turned into a snack dynasty that ruled the streets and everyone’s stomach.
